We ultimately chose to work with LCR given our desire to partner with a credible firm now and in the future. LCR Exteriors is at a different phase in their growth than other firms, but we believed they fit our needs well.

The new roof installation occurred on time and under difficult weather conditions. The crew leaders, including Miguel and Ronaldo, were friendly and worked tirelessly to support their crew. We understood the timeline and different contingencies, such as the potential need for plywood if there was rot underneath the existing shingles. Communication was clear, both on the ground and in the customer portal site. Final inspection went well, and we had no complaints.
